mapper.sql: id, refund_order_no, payment_order_no, payment_amount, refund_amount, status, reason, unique_refund_no, fail_reason, refund_success_time, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select from order_refund
and refund_order_no like concat('%', #{refundOrderNo}, '%')
and payment_order_no like concat('%', #{paymentOrderNo}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by id desc
select count(*) from order_refund where refund_order_no = #{refundOrderNo}
mapper.insert: insert into order_refund (refund_order_no, payment_order_no, payment_amount, refund_amount, status, reason, unique_refund_no, fail_reason, refund_success_time, created_at, updated_at) values (#{refundOrderNo}, #{paymentOrderNo}, #{paymentAmount}, #{refundAmount}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{uniqueRefundNo}, #{failReason}, #{refundSuccessTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update order_refund set status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = now() where refund_order_no = #{refundOrderNo} and status = 'INIT'

update order_refund set status = 'SUCCESS', unique_refund_no = #{uniqueRefundNo}, refund_success_time = #{refundSuccessTime}, updated_at = now() where refund_order_no = #{refundOrderNo} and status in ('INIT', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS')
update order_refund set status = 'FAIL', fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = now() where refund_order_no = #{refundOrderNo} and status in ('INIT', 'PROCESSING')
update order_payment set refunded_amount = refunded_amount + #{refundAmount}, updated_at = now() where order_no = #{paymentOrderNo}
